title: Federated Nonparametric Regression with Heterogeneous Clients
abstract: arXiv:2610.32178v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Whether a federated predictor benefits an individual client depends on both population heterogeneity and estimation uncertainty. We study this question for Nadaraya--Watson regression in a triangular array with potentially different fitting and evaluation distributions. Each client transmits local kernel summaries, allowing the server to construct a covariate-density-weighted federated estimator without centralizing individual observations. A client combines its fitted local predictor with the federated predictor through a prescribed weight, and gain is the paired reduction in squared prediction loss on an independent audit observation. Exact identities characterize both the gain of the realized fitted pair and its repeated-fitting mean. We also establish pointwise inference for the federated estimator. translated_title: 具有异构客户端的联邦非参数回归
translated_abstract: 联邦预测器是否能使单个客户端受益，取决于总体异质性和估计不确定性两个方面。我们在三角阵列设置下针对Nadaraya-Watson回归研究这一问题，其中拟合分布与评估分布可能不同。每个客户端仅传输本地核摘要，使服务器能够在不集中个体观测数据的情况下构建一个以协变量密度加权的联邦估计器。客户端通过预设权重将其拟合的本地预测器与联邦预测器相结合，增益定义为在独立审计观测上配对的平方预测损失的减少量。我们给出了精确恒等式，用以刻画已实现拟合配对的增益及其重复拟合均值。我们还为联邦估计器建立了逐点推断。对客户端增益的两阶段分析将拟合变异性与审计变异性分离，并保留了当客户端（原文在此处截断）
tldr: 该论文提出一种联邦Nadaraya-Watson非参数回归方法，客户端仅传输本地核摘要即可构建协变量密度加权的联邦估计器，并通过精确恒等式与两阶段分析刻画异构客户端从联邦预测中获益的条件及统计推断。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a federated Nadaraya-Watson nonparametric regression framework where clients transmit only local kernel summaries to build a covariate-density-weighted federated estimator, using exact identities and a two-stage analysis to characterize when heterogeneous clients gain from federated prediction.
